metadata.case_name: LAU CHAK SING v. KU KIN YIP AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: driver/delivery man by a company selling kerosene and L.P. Gas
plaintiff.occupation_after: selling and distributing kerosene and L.P. gas on his own account

injuries.description: communited fracture of the mid shaft of the right femur.
injuries.body_part: mid shaft of the right femur
source: As a result of the accident the Plaintiff was admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital suffering from a communited fracture of the mid shaft of the right femur.

injuries.description: head injuries which caused a 4 hour period of post traumatic amnesia.
source: He also suffered head injuries which caused a 4 hour period of post traumatic amnesia.
injuries.icd_description: Concussion with incomplete loss of consciousness with amnesia

manifestations.description: 4 hour period of post traumatic amnesia
heel of his right shoe was raised 1"
walked with a limp and needed a rest after walking for about 15 minutes
difficulty in lifting heavy objects and the impossibility of carrying heavy objects up staircases
slight angulation of the legs and reduction in both the external and internal rotation of the leg
impairment of the whole man assessed at 10%
inability to partake in football and other physical activities enjoyed before the accident

treatments_received: physiotherapy (attended Kwai Chung Clinic three times a week)

losses.description: Walking limited; walked with a limp and needed a rest after about 15 minutes; heel of right shoe raised 1".

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Inability to partake in football and other physical activities enjoyed before the accident.
Required his wife to assist him to help with lifting L.P. gas cylinders.
Required his wife to assist him to remember orders, addresses etc.
Poor memory since the accident impacting his occupation.

comparable_cases.case_name: Lau Chow Lum v Fung Mong-yan
comparable_cases.injury_description: Shortening of leg less than in present case; loss of internal and external rotation; impairment assessed at 7%
